hero.lead: From an idea to a site that is live and handed over to you. Design is one part of it: the idea, the logic, the code, the launch and the handover get the same care.

phases.title: Discover
phases.summary: The idea, the business logic and, when the project needs it, a spec.

steps.title: Idea review
steps.text: Goals, audience, what the site must and must not do.

steps.title: Business logic
steps.text: Scenarios step by step: who comes, what they do, what happens next.

steps.title: Spec, if needed
steps.text: Pages, features, integrations and limits in writing.

phases.title: Design
phases.summary: From the whole to the details — each level approved before the next.

steps.title: Overall concept
steps.text: Several directions for the whole site; one is chosen.

steps.title: Page concepts
steps.text: Key pages in variants on one canvas.

steps.title: Components and the kit
steps.text: Each element in variants, decided one by one; the design system is built from them.

steps.title: All pages
steps.text: Every page from the kit, in both themes and languages.

post.text: The whole path of this site's design is in {post}.

phases.title: Build
phases.summary: Short slices, each one on its own preview link.

steps.title: Start in one command
steps.text: The repository, its rules, checks and workflow set up from a short brief with my own Claude Code plugin libraries.

steps.title: Short slices
steps.text: Each change gets a preview link; you review the work as it goes.

steps.title: Checks
steps.text: Tests, accessibility, both themes and languages before a slice is done.

phases.title: Launch & handover
phases.summary: The site goes live and everything moves into your name.

steps.title: Launch
steps.text: Domain, hosting, HTTPS, analytics, search basics.

steps.title: Handover
steps.text: Repository, accesses and short docs; a walkthrough of updating content.

canvas.title: You choose on a canvas
canvas.text: Concepts, components and pages come as variants side by side, with a recommendation on each. You compare them, comment right on the design and pick one; the choice is marked and the next step builds on it. Nothing is coded before it is approved.
canvas.label: Three design variants, one chosen

command.title: A project starts in one command
command.text: I keep my own plugin libraries for Claude Code. From a short brief they set up the repository, its rules, checks and the commit and review flow — this site was started that way. Less setup, the same quality bar on every project.

registered.title: How I am registered
registered.text: Work goes under a contract with invoices and closing documents; prices are fixed per step or per project before the work starts.

offer.title: Want a site like this one?
offer.text: A few days of development and agreeing the requirements — or longer, for something bigger.

kinds.title: Personal or business card site
kinds.text: Like this one, or a few pages about you and what you offer.

kinds.title: Shop or service site
kinds.text: A catalogue or price list, a request or booking form.

kinds.title: Something bigger
kinds.text: Every requirement taken into account, with support and room to grow.
